title: Prediction
description: The immutable prediction record plus its authorized publication_state lifecycle (Architecture Baseline sections 7.7-7.8). This schema represents STATE ONLY. It does not encode or enforce: (a) which publication-state transitions are valid (DRAFT to PUBLISHED, PUBLISHED to SUPERSEDED, PUBLISHED to WITHDRAWN, and no other) -- that is domain/application logic in engine/src/footcap_engine/predictions/; (b) the official-prediction uniqueness invariant (at most one PUBLISHED record per match_id + PRE_MATCH horizon + PRODUCTION context) -- that is a database/domain concern; (c) that the three probability fields sum to a valid distribution within tolerance -- that is a numeric domain-logic check, not a structural JSON Schema constraint. This schema also does not itself restrict public API exposure: it describes the full internal shape across all lifecycle states, including DRAFT, which is persistent and internal and must never be served by a public endpoint (Architecture Baseline sections 10.2-10.3); that filtering is enforced by the Application API layer, not by this schema.

prediction_run_id.description: Immutable reference to the Prediction Run that produced this Prediction.

publication_state.description: Present, and required, only when evaluation_context is PRODUCTION. Must be genuinely absent -- not present with a null value -- for BACKTEST and EXPERIMENT records, whose execution/result state is represented by the linked Prediction Run's status instead (Architecture Baseline sections 7.7-7.8: 'publication_state applies only to PRODUCTION Prediction records').

supersedes_prediction_id.description: Present only on a PRODUCTION replacement; points to its immediate prior official Prediction. Absent for a first-ever publication. Must remain within the same match_id + PRE_MATCH + PRODUCTION and must not create cycles, branches, or cross-match/context links (Architecture Baseline section 7.8) -- not enforced by this schema.

home_probability.description: Home win probability. Structural range only; that home_probability + draw_probability + away_probability sum to a valid distribution within tolerance is a domain-logic check, not enforced here.

draw_probability.description: Draw probability. See home_probability for the distribution-sum caveat.

away_probability.description: Away win probability. See home_probability for the distribution-sum caveat.

$comment: publication_state applies only to PRODUCTION Prediction records (Architecture Baseline section 7.8). This if/then/else makes that a structural rule: required when evaluation_context is PRODUCTION; genuinely absent (the 'not: required' form rejects the key whether or not it carries a null value) when evaluation_context is BACKTEST or EXPERIMENT. Resolved in the Phase 0.4.1A read-only review; no schema-encoded lifecycle transition logic is introduced by this conditional.
